subject: science
passage: When the moss or lichen they inhabit dries out, many tardigrades, microscopic animals about half a millimeter long, draw in their legs, lose nearly all of their body water, and contract into a compact form called a tun. In this state their metabolism falls to a tiny fraction of its normal rate, so low that some biologists describe it as effectively ______: the animal is neither carrying on the ordinary processes of life nor dead, and it can remain this way for years until water returns and revives it.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text says the metabolism falls so low that the animal is "neither carrying on the ordinary processes of life nor dead" and can later be revived. The blank needs a word for a process that has been halted but not ended for good, which is "suspended."
explanation.A: Incorrect. The text says metabolism "falls to a tiny fraction of its normal rate," the opposite of speeding up.
explanation.B: Correct. "Suspended" means temporarily stopped, which matches a state that is neither ordinary life nor death and that ends when water "revives" the animal.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Regulated" suggests the metabolism is being actively controlled and kept running, but the text says the ordinary processes of life have essentially stopped.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nothing in the text says the metabolism is hidden; the point is that it has nearly stopped.
